query: SELECT t.error, count(*) AS "count!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.acknowledged_at IS NOT NULL) AS "cleared!", array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT p.slug), NULL) AS "providers!", array_agg(DISTINCT t.kind) AS "kinds!", max(t.finished_at) AS latest_at FROM scan_tasks t JOIN scan_runs r ON r.id = t.run_id LEFT JOIN providers p ON p.id = r.provider_id WHERE t.state = 'failed' AND ($1::text IS NULL OR p.slug = $1) AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR t.finished_at >= $2) AND ($3::bool OR t.acknowledged_at IS NULL) GROUP BY t.error ORDER BY count(*) DESC, max(t.finished_at) DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT $4
